description: This Java class 'GlobalLocaleList' manages a cache of allowed locale settings in the OpenMRS system, updating the list whenever relevant global property changes occur.

classes.name: GlobalLocaleList
classes.description: A utility class that caches and manages the list of allowed locales based on global property changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the cache of allowed locales when the global property value changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Invalidates the cache when the global property is deleted.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if a property name is the one this class listens to.

methods.name: getAllowedLocales
methods.description: Returns the current set of allowed Locales.
